title: Make room for fresh Naam to settle
summary: Freshness does not come from more movement; it comes when the mind is joined to the True Guru and Naam abides within. Let the mind stay long enough for the newness to come from inside.
takeaway: Let the True Guru hold the mind long enough for Naam to arrive fresh.
lifeApplication: Before adding another stimulation or plan, sit with one line of Bani until the hunger for novelty starts to lose authority.

source.shortMeaning: The True Guru breaks old cycles and lets the ever-fresh Naam abide within the mind.
source.lifeApplication: Stay with the Guru’s word before reaching for novelty; let freshness come from Naam rather than motion.

evidence.coreClaim: The True Guru breaks old cycles and lets the ever-fresh Naam abide within the mind.
evidence.turn: The shabad redirects restlessness away from novelty and toward the Shabad that lets Naam settle inside.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before adding another stimulation or plan, sit with one line of Bani until the hunger for novelty starts to lose authority.
